subject: Cleanup and break the while loop in clusterPrimariesHaveReplicas (#3075)
reason: The change is a pure refactor: clusterPrimariesHaveReplicas previously summed num_replicas over all primaries and returned (sum != 0); it now returns 1 at the first primary with num_replicas != 0. Because num_replicas is a non-negative count, the two forms compute the identical boolean for every cluster state — the loop merely exits early. The only caller, clusterNodeSetSlotBit, sets the MIGRATE_TO flag under exactly the same conditions as before, so there is no observable behaviour change to test.
